invitation_message: Hi there, I’m Emily from BRKOX. We offer LED light kits, wall display frames, and acrylic display cases compatible with LEGO® sets, helping fans across the US light up and showcase their favorite builds. We’d love to invite you to join our affiliate program on Awin and earn commission on qualifying sales you refer. We’re happy to provide product images, product information, and recommendations to help you find the right fit for your audience. Accept our invitation on Awin to get started, or send us a message with any questions. We’d love to work with you!
